clipsToCapture.shows: A player dials Report a crime at a payphone; an officer on duty hears it on the radio and the dispatch board lists it.
A player is shot and goes down, a medic clocks in at the hospital desk and revives them.
A player drills the cash van's box at the bank doorstep and money sacks appear.
Pick a lock-up door, hotwire the car, drive it into the chop shop yard and watch the payout.
An officer arrests a robber at the fuel till and the robber ends up in the cell.
A new player fills in form R-89 and the clerk hands over an ID card on the square.
